cpu_substages.scope: Per-frame totals of observed CPU calls on complete details paired with eligible present intervals. Missing calls are omitted, not zero-filled. Parent spans include these times; do not add them. No GPU-time or performance-pass verdict.

cpu_detail.scope: Observed CPU encode phases and counters only for complete detail and substage attempts on a complete primary capture, paired with eligible present intervals. Incomplete rows retain partial counters in the evidence, never in distributions. Missing observations are unavailable, not zero. Parent spans include child times; do not add or subtract parent/child percentiles or infer GPU time. No performance-pass verdict. Geometry upload includes pooled staging copies; encoder creation is encode_submit residual before that phase. Staging gauges describe retained source capacity and pending sources at upload exit, not cumulative allocation totals. GPU command-span timestamps start after staged copies and exclude them.

gpu.scope: GPU timestamps around the main ordered frame command buffer; excludes other submissions, CPU work, surface acquisition, present/scan-out and trailing timestamp resolve/readback; backend/driver timestamp ordering and precision apply; eligible retained-present subset only; missing samples may bias this subset. No FPS, scan-out, or target-performance verdict.
